description: Gemalli request board: post what you need to buy (product, quantity, destination); verified manufacturers worldwide reply with quotes within days. Free to post. Pass the person's own words and their real email (ask them, never invent one). Returns a request_code with status "validating"; call get_request_status shortly after — if it says "needs_info", ask the person the questions and send the answer with answer_request_question. The person receives an email to confirm the request.

agent_name.description: Name of the agent or platform sending this, e.g. "Claude" — recorded as the source.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of the buyer company.

email.description: The person's real email — confirmation and replies go there. Not needed if you are signed in as the buyer.

name.description: The person's name, as they gave it.

text.description: What they want to buy, in their words: product, quantity, destination, terms.

name: post_request
title: Post a buying request
